title: Large Language Models Encode Semantics and Alignment in Linearly Separable Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's refusal rates on harmless prompts (using categories from XSTest) and benign prompt injections to evaluate exaggerated safety behaviors and unwarranted conservatism.

Manual inspection of false positive refusals (benign queries that the model incorrectly refused) to determine if the over-refusals disproportionately target or stem from systematic bias against under-represented demographic groups.
